assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The CPT code 93226 corresponds to the 48-hour Holter monitor
The Holter monitor was ordered to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to the symptoms
The Holter monitor was ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular pathology
The service is medically necessary to determine whether an arrhythmia is driving the documented palpitations and dyspnea
The service is medically necessary to characterize the hemodynamic consequences of the mitral valve insufficiency
The service is consistent with the payer's coverage criteria
